params.name: Sigil of Malice
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} projects an orb at the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and marking them for a short time.
params.blurb2: Her next damaging ability against the marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' projects an orb at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and marks them for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, with {{as|{{pp|10 to 146|formula= 2 + 8 * level, capped at level 18}}<!--stops at 18--> '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.
params.description2: '''LeBlanc's''' next damaging {{tip|champion ability|ability}} against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the {{ccs|same {{as|magic damage}}|magic}} again.
params.description3: ''Sigil of Malice's'' orb refunds 100% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and 30% of its remaining {{sti|cooldown}} if either the orb or its mark's consumption kills the target.
params.notes:
* ''Sigil of Malice'' and {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} can detonate each other's marks.
* The floating damage text upon the mark's detonation currently displays a real [[File:Critical strike magic icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon for magic damage critical strikes]] critical strike icon instead of a success indicator.{{bug}}{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.name: Distortion
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival. She leaves behind a return pad at her original location that lasts a few seconds, during which she can recast.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival and leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds. ''Distortion'' can be recast after {{fd|0.2}} seconds of the dash ending for the pad's duration.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to ''Distortion's'' return pad, regardless of range.
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (first cast clamped)
params.notes:
* ''Distortion'' has no minimum dash range.
* ''Distortion'' will be buffered and cast as soon as the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cooldown ending.
** The {{sbc|recast}} will be buffered and cast as soon as it becomes available if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.3}} seconds of it becoming available to cast.
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Recasting the ability does not.
**{{ai|Mimic: Distortion|LeBlanc}} has the same properties.
* ''Distortion'' and {{ai|Mimic: Distortion|LeBlanc}} have independent return pads and '''LeBlanc''' can travel to both while they are active.
* ''Distortion's'' pad duration starts once the dash ends.

params.name: Ethereal Chains
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|tether|tethers}} the first enemy hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
params.blurb2: The tether lasts a brief time, after which the target is dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|true sight|revealed}}, and briefly {{tip|root|rooted}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits and forms a {{tip|tether}} between '''LeBlanc''' and the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.description2: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target and {{tip|root}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Fracture Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|50+80 to 130+240}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+85}}% AP)}}}}
params.tether radius: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|865|Equivalent to 995 center-to-center range against the average enemy champion}}
params.notes:
* Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate {{ai|Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}}.
* ''Ethereal Chains'' and {{ai|Mimic: Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc}} are separate debuffs, and can both be tethered to the same target without overriding each other. The {{tip|root}} duration for either one are unchanged.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
* The tether remains for a minimum of {{fd|0.25}} seconds regardless of distance. 
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|LeBlanc}} casts a mimicked version of her most recent ability, which deals modified damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' casts a mimicked version of her most recently used basic ability, applying the same effects and dealing {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Mimic: Sigil of Malice:}} The orb deals modified damage, while the mark consumption deals double that amount.
params.leveling2: {{st|Orb Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Mark Magic Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 230*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 230*3}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
params.description4: {{sbc|Mimic: Ethereal Chains:}} The tether's application deals modified damage, while its fracturing deals double that amount.
params.leveling4: {{st|Application Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Fracture Magic Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 230*2}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 230*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+85}}% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Mimic'' will default to {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} if ''LeBlanc'' ranks up ''Mimic'' without having used any abilities beforehand (even if she has not yet learned {{ai|Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}}).
* Both {{ai|Mimic: Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc}} and {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} will apply damage twice if the original ability's condition to do so is met.

params.name: Mirror Image
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} When {{ci|LeBlanc}} reaches low health, she creates a {{tip|clone|clone}} of herself and together they enter brief {{tip|invisibility}}.
params.blurb2: The clone will run forward to a random location, and lasts for a period.
params.blurb3: ''Mirror Image'' will go on cooldown upon triggering.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to {{sti|health|{{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}}}, she creates a {{tip|clone}} of herself, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisibility|invisible}} for 1 second.
params.description2: The clone can cast basic attacks with no effect and lasts 8 seconds. Upon spawning, it starts moving up to 1900 units toward a random direction in front of '''LeBlanc's''' movement, determined at the moment of its spawning.
